_about: Hand-written ground truth per still (kind + note); scripts/extract_still_landmarks.py merges it into index.json. Kinds: ok: positive still; the rules MUST fire exactly this gesture (gated); partial: positive still whose gesture the landmarkers cannot see (arm-only crop, no face mesh); a miss is tolerated and reported, any OTHER emote is a false trigger (gated); occluded: yawn with a hand over the mouth; must NOT fire another gesture, a miss is tolerated (reported); neutral: negative still that looks like a person at rest or talking; MUST fire nothing (gated); hard: hard negative (scream, cover-eyes, dab); should fire nothing, gated at <= 3 wrong firings across all hard stills; skip: unusable still, ignored
